svg.title: A/B Continuity Atlas — James within an ongoing movement
svg.desc: An illuminated continuous mathematical weave extends into the view from the left and continues past James, who is marked on the weave as a current human observer rather than a central origin. Six colorful inquiry worlds are connected by exploratory traces across the moving field. At the far right an open unfinished aperture labeled HUMAN? marks what James hopes to witness, not an established future event. Source relationships retain their own evidence requirements.
svg.text: THE MOVEMENT IS NOT JAMES. JAMES IS HERE TO OBSERVE IT.
